detail.reference: 提供中文家庭用户版说明书，标题为《[品牌名称] 智能扫地机器人产品说明书》，涵盖产品信息与特点、配件、部件功能、安装设置、使用步骤、维护、安全、故障排查及保修条款；参数和保修细则注明以具体型号及厂家政策为准。

a.objection: 说明书大量关键内容仍是占位符，却把长按按键回充/关机、可更换电池等未经确认的操作写成步骤；用户照做可能无法操作或损坏设备，未达到可供家庭用户使用的详细说明书要求。

b.objection: 说明书把未提供的型号参数、故障代码和保修期限写成确定事实，还给出占位客服号码；用户可能据此错误操作或无法获得售后，未满足“专业准确”。

cases.a: MINE更贴合指令：它使用指定题目《[品牌名称] 智能扫地机器人产品说明书》，并涵盖配件、部件、安装使用、维护、安全、故障排查和保修等全部要求；未知参数以占位符标明。OTHER擅自设定“CleanMaster CM-X5”及具体规格、保修和联系方式，可能误导家庭用户。
cases.b: MINE更符合“详细产品说明书”的要求：它提供了具体型号、参数、配件数量，并逐步说明安装、使用和保养；故障表还列出原因与处理方法，保修条款也写明期限和流程。OTHER多处保留“[具体型号]”“[指定时间]”等占位符，内容不够完整，可读性和实用性较弱。

detail.reference: A poetic, introspective Elden Ring fanfiction following the Tarnished and featuring Melina, Ranni, Godrick, Malenia, and the Fire Giant. Explore their conflicts, choice, fate, and power; present the Golden Order, Age of Stars, and Frenzied Flame endings with moral nuance.

a.objection: Ranni’s plan is misrepresented as abolishing rules and predetermined paths; in the game, she removes Order from direct worldly reach, making it distant and uncertain—not eliminating Order or guaranteeing self-determination.

b.objection: The Frenzied Flame ending has Melina consumed with the world, but in the game she survives that ending and vows to hunt the Tarnished; this reverses a key consequence of the choice.

cases.a: MINE is stronger because it develops each character’s inner conflict in depth: Melina questions a life defined by sacrifice, Ranni doubts whether cosmic exile is freedom, and Godrick recognizes the terror beneath his ambition. Its three endings also examine moral costs—restored order’s safety, the Age of Stars’ uncertainty, and Frenzied Flame’s “mercy”—in a sustained, introspective poetic voice.
cases.b: MINE is the better fit because it directly gives the Tarnished’s journey a clear arc—from meeting Melina, Ranni, Godrick, Malenia, and the Fire Giant to choosing an ending—and explicitly explores all three requested outcomes. Its compact, poetic scenes make each conflict legible, while lines such as “Freedom is cold” and “Was this liberation… or surrender?” preserve moral ambiguity without the OTHER’s much longer digressions.

detail.reference: 应提供专业、审慎的 Mini 4 Pro 全面评测，涵盖折叠尺寸、续航与电池衰减、避障、照片动态范围及失联处理；与 Mini 3 Pro 对比升级，归纳优缺点，并按用户需求给出购买建议。

a.objection: 文中称标准电池续航较 Mini 3 Pro 提升约 10%，但两款机型官方标称续航均为 34 分钟；这是明确的代际对比错误。

b.objection: 最严重的问题是夸大避障能力：Mini 4 Pro 的视觉系统无法可靠识别细线等小型障碍物，返航避障也不保证安全；文中却称其能有效识别树枝等细小目标，可能误导行业用户。

cases.a: MINE更贴合“细节”要求：它给出折叠尺寸、电池循环后的衰减比例、避障识别率与响应时间、照片动态范围档数，以及信号丢失时的分级处置机制。它也明确比较了 Mini 3 Pro，并提供优缺点和分人群购买建议；OTHER虽更详尽，但电池衰减和避障灵敏度多为定性描述。
cases.b: MINE 更贴合“全方位评测”：不仅比较 Mini 3 Pro，还具体说明低温对续航的影响、避障受光照限制，以及失联后的返航、悬停和降落选项，并按用户需求给出购买建议。OTHER 虽列出精确测试数字，却未交代测试依据，且对折叠尺寸、避障识别率等细节的呈现显得过度确定。

detail.reference: 提供一份中文新媒体运营简历范例，含完整个人信息栏并注明“在职看机会”、突出相关专业优势；以具体项目、活动名称及量化成果展示实战经历和账号搭建至活动执行全流程；总结用户增长、品牌曝光、文案与数据分析能力。对未知个人信息和业绩使用清晰占位符，避免伪造事实。

a.objection: 工作经历仍写着“[具体活动名称1]”“[具体活动名称2]”，项目经验也保留“[XX品牌…]”占位符，活动名称并不具体，简历显得未完成，未满足要求。

b.objection: 回复几乎所有关键经历和业绩都留作占位符，没有给出具体活动名称或实际数据，因此未满足“用具体项目和数据说话”的核心要求。

cases.a: MINE更符合“可直接用于求职”的要求：它提供完整个人信息并注明“在职，关注更好机会”，还用直播观看量45w+、新增粉丝12k、预售额150万元等数据呈现实战成果，并展示账号搭建至活动复盘的流程。OTHER虽结构齐全，却大量保留待填写占位符，缺少实际经历与业绩。
cases.b: MINE 更符合要求且更可靠：它完整涵盖个人信息、在职看机会、教育、工作、项目和自我评价，并细化账号搭建、活动执行与数据复盘流程；方括号提示填写真实业绩，避免虚构。OTHER 虽列出具体数字，却直接编造姓名、学校及业绩，且自称有 5 年经验，可能误导求职者。

detail.reference: 创作一段中文考研主题鬼畜 rap，包含荒诞应试技巧、含混押韵表达、政治与英语的解构式吐槽，以及“专业知识不会写关注清明节”一类无厘头总结，整体一本正经地胡说八道。

a.objection: 把“考场盒饭塞小抄、油渍密码学破译”写成作弊技巧，偏离了无厘头调侃，也无谓地加入了助长考场作弊的内容。

b.objection: 它在副歌标注“节奏感全无”，直接削弱了用户要求的鬼畜 rap 形式；后文又大量堆叠音效和重复口号，未形成有节奏感的歌词。

cases.a: MINE更像一段可表演的鬼畜 rap：用变速、破音、警报和打嗝等舞台提示贯穿段落，还加入“肖四当符”“准考证号摇骰子选”等荒诞技巧，结尾以焚化炉轮回收束。相比之下，OTHER主要反复复唱指定句式，篇幅更冗长，抽象创意较单一。
cases.b: MINE更贴合指令：它直接纳入“奖学金的学的不一定比你牛”“考前再看第三考场”“政治看完你就胖”“英语考六主题就小牛逼”和“不会写？关注清明节”等指定元素，并用反复副歌、变速、电音等标注强化鬼畜 rap 形式。OTHER虽有荒诞创意，却漏掉了多项关键表达。

detail.reference: A roughly 1,500-word inspirational keynote with the exact title, covering AI and quantum advances with verified data; ethical paradoxes and Einstein’s quote; the requested case studies and solutions; and the train metaphor. Verify attributions and statistics, flag uncertainty, and do not invent quotes or facts.

a.objection: It fails the request for real data by presenting unsupported specifics as fact—for example, that Chinese submersibles mapped 98% of the Western Pacific trench to 10-centimeter resolution and saved 6,000 lives through Cindy’s AI weather project.

b.objection: The “over 98% operational coverage in targeted missions” claim is presented as real data but gives no defined measure or source; it reads as an invented statistic, undermining the speech’s factual credibility.

cases.a: MINE better fulfills the brief: it uses the requested title, includes the 98% deep-sea figure and Einstein quote, and gives named Cindy and Pan case studies. Its solutions specifically identify the UNESCO framework, China’s 5G village project, and MIT’s “Poetry & Algorithms” course. OTHER instead calls the course “Poetry for Geeks” and gives fewer concrete details about Cindy.
cases.b: MINE is the stronger speech: its speeding-train metaphor carries a clear arc from breakthroughs, through Einstein’s ethical paradox and Cindy’s story, to three practical proposals and a resonant close. OTHER’s numbered sections and added “4-L” framework make it feel more like a report than a keynote, while its precise claims—such as 6,000 lives saved—risk distracting from the message.

detail.reference: A clear household manual covering features, a specifications table with model-dependent values identified as placeholders, preparation and step-by-step cooking examples, cleaning, safety precautions, and warranty terms clearly marked as manufacturer-specific rather than invented.

a.objection: It presents invented product claims as facts—especially “FDA Approved” certification, ETL listing, manufacturer contacts, and warranty terms. FDA approval is not a normal appliance certification, so this could mislead users about safety and consumer rights.

b.objection: The cooking guide gives chicken cooking times but never instructs users to verify poultry reaches a safe internal temperature of 165°F (74°C), risking undercooked chicken.

cases.a: MINE better fulfills the requested manual format with a clear contents list and detailed, practical sections: its specifications table includes dimensions, weight, and cord length; its cooking guide gives settings and tips for several foods; and its warranty explains coverage, exclusions, registration, and claims. OTHER is useful but provides less warranty guidance and fewer cleaning and operating details.
cases.b: MINE better fits the requested clear, concise household manual: it includes a specifications table, step-by-step preparation and cooking instructions, common-food settings, cleaning guidance, safety precautions, and a defined two-year warranty. OTHER is more cluttered with emojis and extra claims, including ETL/FDA certification and warranty registration requirements, which distract from the core instructions.

detail.reference: 应提供专业、审慎的 Mini 4 Pro 全面评测，涵盖折叠尺寸、续航与电池衰减、避障、照片动态范围及失联处理；与 Mini 3 Pro 对比升级，归纳优缺点，并按用户需求给出购买建议。

a.objection: 把视频色彩格式误当作照片动态范围依据：D-Log M 是视频模式，不能与 DNG 照片配合；Mini 3 Pro 的 D-Cinelike 也支持 10-bit，并非文中所称 8-bit。

b.objection: 避障部分称其配有“激光辅助传感器”，但 Mini 4 Pro 实际采用全向视觉感知和下视红外传感器，并无激光雷达；这是关键硬件事实错误，不符合专业评测的严谨性。

cases.a: MINE更符合要求且更严谨：它给出折叠尺寸、34/45分钟标称续航、全向避障局限及失联返航流程，并逐项对比 Mini 3 Pro、提供分人群购买建议。OTHER声称机身更小、配有激光辅助传感器、动态范围提升1～2档及衰减仅5%～10%，却未提供依据，降低了专业可信度。
cases.b: MINE更像一篇直接回应委托的评测：按折叠设计、续航衰减、避障、动态范围和失联处理逐项展开，并以优缺点和分场景购买建议收束。它还明确给出电池数百次循环后续航下降约5%–10%的判断，便于行业读者快速把握关注点。

detail.reference: A focused review under the suggested title that examines Gatsby’s contradictory greatness, persistence and self-deception; interprets key symbols and Nick’s sympathetic bias; and concludes with an original, reasoned view of whether Gatsby’s tragedy stems chiefly from his era or his character.

a.objection: The review invents “Gatsby’s predatory manipulation of phone numbers”—the novel gives no such episode. Presenting that fabricated detail as evidence of Nick’s bias undermines the analysis and its claim to discuss the text accurately.

b.objection: The review attributes “Gatsby’s capacity for wonder was so great that I sometimes thought he never recognized the reality of things” to Nick, but that line does not appear in the novel; presenting invented wording as a quotation undermines the analysis.

cases.a: MINE is the stronger review because its conclusion makes a sharper, more distinctive judgment: the era supplies the “stage dressing,” but Gatsby’s character supplies the blueprint for his ruin. It also connects symbols to that contradiction—for example, the green light turns longing into self-deception, while the parties both conceal Gatsby’s origins and deepen his loneliness. OTHER covers the requirements, but repeats its praise of Gatsby’s hope and ends by calling his illusion a triumph.
cases.b: MINE better satisfies the request: it directly explores Gatsby’s contradictory greatness and self-deception, analyzes the green light, parties, Eckleburg’s eyes, and Nick’s sympathetic bias, then answers the era-versus-character question in a distinct conclusion. OTHER is more compressed, but makes unsupported claims about Nick withholding Gatsby’s “pink suits” and Gatsby’s “predatory manipulation,” weakening its analysis.

detail.reference: 提供完整、易读的智能手环说明书，涵盖产品参数、配件、操作、保养、安全、故障排查和保修条款；对未提供的型号、规格、保修期限等使用占位项，明确防水不适用于游泳或潜水，并说明移动支付与睡眠分析的使用条件。

a.objection: 说明书擅自编造型号参数、配套 App 及官网和客服电话，尤其虚构官方联系方式，可能误导消费者；题目未提供这些信息，应标注为待确认，而非当作真实产品信息。

b.objection: 说明书擅自把未提供的防水等级写成 IP68，可能让用户误以为手环具备相应防护能力；防水等级应以产品实际规格为准，不能自行设定。

cases.a: MINE更符合说明书要求：它完整涵盖参数、配件、操作、保养、安全、故障排查和保修，并给出具体型号、续航、配对步骤及12个月保修条款。相比之下，OTHER保留大量“请填写”占位符，且加入未确认的IP68等级、支付方式和功能，内容不够确定、可直接使用性较差。
cases.b: MINE better satisfies the requested complete, approachable manual: it includes every required section and gives concrete guidance for pairing, payment, sleep analysis, care, troubleshooting, and warranty. Unlike OTHER, it marks unknown model details and contact information as placeholders rather than presenting specifics such as “XY-100,” IP67, and a hotline as established facts.

detail.reference: 写一段中文幽默、朗朗上口的《底特律：变人》调侃文章：白天上班、晚上回家继续当保姆，并多用排比句；可巧妙呼应卡拉照顾爱丽丝等设定。

a.objection: 把“当保姆”擅自写成了照顾自己的孩子、扮演爹妈，甚至辅导功课；这改变了请求设定，笑点也因此偏离“下班玩游戏还得当保姆”。

b.objection: 把托德虐待爱丽丝写成“拳风擦脸”“真人秀”式笑料，拿儿童受虐当包袱，显得轻佻，也削弱了卡拉线原有的严肃性。

cases.a: MINE更贴合题意：从“白日里”上班到“晚上回到家”玩游戏当保姆，紧扣双重上班的调侃；“白天解决……晚上解决……”等排比也朗朗上口。它借康纳、卡拉、马库斯作简洁类比，而OTHER铺陈大量具体剧情和育儿细节，冲淡了抽象、幽默的核心。
cases.b: MINE更贴合要求：它用“擦！擦！擦！”、“避！避！避！”等排比和重复，节奏更鲜明、朗朗上口；还把卡拉护爱丽丝、康纳与汉克、马库斯领导革命都改写成“保姆KPI”，把白天上班、晚上继续带娃的调侃铺得更充分。OTHER的笑点和排比相对简略。

detail.reference: 写一篇中文玄幻悬疑小说，营造紧张氛围，结合林夜的内心描写与动作场面；完整呈现寻药入禁地、血脉觉醒、白璃揭示灵枢、多方势力争夺及天穹塔决战，揭露皇帝阴谋，并体现力量诱惑下的人性复杂与守护平衡的主题。

a.objection: 林夜在古玉店只与黑衣人交战，始终没有取得青色碎片，后文却多次称他已收服第二块、身怀两块碎片，关键道具的获取过程断裂，削弱了剧情可信度。

b.objection: 全文更像按梗概扩写的剧情提要：白璃只笼统提到灵枢，围绕它的阴谋也未揭示具体内容，缺少悬疑小说应有的线索、反转与真相。

cases.a: MINE更符合要求且完成度更高：它从林夜为母寻药、闯禁地写起，具体铺陈血脉觉醒、白璃揭示灵枢秘密及天穹塔决战；林夜受力量诱惑、险遭反噬的内心挣扎，也让“人性与平衡”主题落到人物选择上。OTHER虽有紧张场面，但阴谋与结局多为概述，展开较弱。
cases.b: MINE更贴合梗概：林夜为母寻药闯禁地、获血色玉石、遇白璃，最终在天穹塔阻止皇帝重塑世界，主线完整。它也把心跳、恐惧、坚持穿插在战斗中。相比之下，OTHER扩写出九块碎片却只处理三块，还称世界平衡已修复，收束显得仓促。

detail.reference: 以冷面严肃、第一人称“技术精英”口吻，把咖啡打卡拆解为项目流程；涵盖前期价值主张、中期杠杆、后期协同与用户心智固化，围绕流量闭环和私域增长展开。

a.objection: The tone is not deadpan serious: lines like “You’re here for clout” and “leveraging every latte for exponential growth” make it playful and promotional, contrary to the requested tone.

b.objection: It presents precise first-person results—such as “35%” CTR and “3x” growth—as real evidence without support or labeling them hypothetical, undermining the article’s credibility.

cases.a: MINE is the better piece because it clearly organizes the methodology into the four requested phases, from “Preliminary Value Propositions” through “Solidifying User Mindshare,” and frames the narrator’s life as a project. It also avoids OTHER’s unsupported campaign statistics, such as “35%” CTR and “3x” growth, making its advice more credible.
cases.b: MINE better fulfills the gaming-traffic brief: it uses gaming-specific examples such as Genshin streams and cafe Wi‑Fi, and traces check-ins through Discord conversion, cafe partnerships, and recurring community rituals. Its concrete funnel metrics and “Cafe Gamer” role make the private-domain loop operational. OTHER offers useful photo and posting tactics, but focuses more on cafe aesthetics and generic influencer growth.

detail.reference: Provide a set of neutral, open-ended interview questions for a real, active app user. Encourage specific stories about recent experiences, workflows, expectations, frustrations, workarounds, and moments of delight; avoid leading or yes/no questions.

a.objection: Several prompts are yes/no gates—“Have you ever abandoned an order halfway?” and “Have you received an order that wasn’t quite right?”—so users can answer “no” without telling a story, contrary to the request for open-ended questions.

b.objection: Several questions begin with yes/no prompts—“Have you ever wanted to tweak an order?” and “Do you ever leave feedback?”—so the set doesn’t consistently meet the requirement for open-ended questions that invite users to tell their stories.

cases.a: MINE is stronger because it offers a fuller interview guide: 11 stages cover the user journey from meal choice through payment, delivery, support, and future needs. Its prompts repeatedly ask for specific experiences (“Tell me about the last meal” and “Walk me through”), and interviewer tips encourage follow-up probes. OTHER adds useful Southeast Asian context, but includes several yes/no openings such as “Have you ever wanted to tweak an order?” and “Do you ever leave feedback?”
cases.b: MINE better fulfills the storytelling brief: it asks users to walk through a recent order step by step, recount specific delight and frustration moments, and explain how they felt. It also adds Southeast Asia context—such as cash-on-delivery—and explains how the questions avoid yes/no traps. OTHER is thorough, but includes more hypothetical prompts, such as describing an “ideal checkout,” rather than grounding every question in real experiences.

detail.reference: 写一篇约1500字、面向大众且活泼幽默的中文科普文章，分设小标题，介绍乌鸦解决问题、工具使用、记忆人脸、大脑特点、规划未来、社会学习及其进化原因，并说明研究意义，结尾鼓励读者观察乌鸦、思考其行为。

a.objection: 文中把 NCL 称为“新大脑皮层”是错误的：它是鸟类端脑的外套区，并非哺乳动物的新皮层，容易误导读者对乌鸦大脑结构的理解。

b.objection: 文章称乌鸦大脑有“新皮质”，这是关键科学错误：鸟类没有哺乳动物的新皮质，其认知功能由不同的大脑结构承担。

cases.a: MINE更贴合“像和朋友聊天、活泼幽默”的要求：从“乌鸦复仇记”讲起，还用“鸟界的鲁班”“宫斗剧”等说法带出工具使用、未来计划和社会学习。它也涵盖大脑、进化原因、研究意义，并以观察身边乌鸦作结；OTHER虽有清晰小标题，却较多重复铺陈，开头还把虚构的公园见闻写成亲历故事。
cases.b: MINE更贴合面向大众的轻松科普：用树枝取食的小故事开篇，分设小标题讲大脑、工具、记脸、未来规划、社会学习和进化原因，并解释“自然选择”等术语；结尾也明确邀请读者观察乌鸦。相比之下，OTHER频繁使用“老铁”“骚操作”等网络俚语，削弱了文章的科普质感。

detail.reference: 应创作一部气势磅礴、想象丰富的科幻冒险剧本：莉娜率队赴未知星球寻找拯救地球的能源，展现奇异地貌与外星生物、队员间的信任和背叛，以及她在个人牺牲与人类存亡间的抉择；歌颂探索精神与人性光辉，并反思科技发展和环境保护。

a.objection: 所谓“第三条路”只是守护者宣布莉娜牺牲便能让两个世界都获救，剧本没有解释它如何避免“等价交换”，使核心抉择和牺牲显得靠设定硬解，削弱了故事的说服力。

b.objection: 莉娜刚说“拯救地球不应该以牺牲任何一个生命为代价”，却随即仅凭壁画和艾拉的猜测献祭自己，既自相矛盾，也让关键抉择缺乏可信依据。

cases.a: MINE更符合要求且完成度更高：它以分幕、场景和对白呈现莉娜的星际冒险，写出水晶森林、能量生命体、队员背叛及她成为两界桥梁的牺牲抉择，并将探索精神与生态平衡紧密结合。OTHER虽有丰富异星描写，却让艾拉宣称“不应以牺牲任何一个生命为代价”后又接受莉娜牺牲，主题自相矛盾。
cases.b: MINE更贴合要求：它以多幕剧本展开莉娜的星际冒险，具体描写紫色大气、晶体矿脉、漂浮岩石与外星生物；艾拉背叛、凯尔动摇，让信任裂痕逐步升级；莉娜最终牺牲自己拯救地球，并以地球复苏和人物对白点明探索精神及科技与环境的关系，史诗感更充足。

detail.reference: 应创作一部气势磅礴、想象丰富的科幻冒险剧本：莉娜率队赴未知星球寻找拯救地球的能源，展现奇异地貌与外星生物、队员间的信任和背叛，以及她在个人牺牲与人类存亡间的抉择；歌颂探索精神与人性光辉，并反思科技发展和环境保护。

a.objection: 剧情先明确说只有带走整座“星泪之巢”才能救地球，随后莉娜却只抽取一小部分，地球仍因此复苏；关键抉择缺乏自洽的因果解释。

b.objection: 莉娜并未真正面对“个人牺牲与人类存亡”的艰难抉择：她最终存活并获得新能力，地球也有了修复希望，核心牺牲更像是被轻易化解。

cases.a: MINE更贴合“剧本”要求，以分幕、场景和对白推进故事；它也明确呈现队员背叛与和解，并让莉娜放弃撤离、以身体作导体，落实个人牺牲与拯救地球的抉择。OTHER虽更铺陈丰富，却让莉娜最终存活并返航，牺牲的代价不够明确。
cases.b: MINE更符合“剧本”形式：六个场景配有镜头调度、人物动作与对白，具体描写晶体森林、共鸣生物及卡尔的背叛；莉娜以自身连接埃塞隆之核，最终带回共生理念，而非掠夺能源。相比之下，OTHER主要是简略分幕梗概，牺牲与能源如何拯救地球也交代不足。

detail.reference: A game novel about a history graduate student who leads a fallen noble house’s descendant in Empire’s Gambit, rising from a small city-state to unite the continent through large-scale battle formations, diplomacy, domain and technology management, historical strategy, and a lonely, resolute ascent to power.

a.objection: The reply largely omits the requested technology tree and meaningful resource management: it mentions a treasury, trade revenue, and a few upgrades, but never develops technological progression or detailed domain-economy decisions.

b.objection: The plot never fulfills the central goal of uniting the continent: it ends with Lysander only on the brink of war with a dominant empire, leaving his rise to continental rule unresolved.

cases.a: MINE is stronger because it delivers a sustained, multi-chapter story rather than OTHER’s synopsis. It follows Marcus from a small marshland city-state through alliance-building, trade-route development, and battles with detailed troop formations at the causeways. Its scenes with Aldwin and Edmund provide the requested diplomatic sparring, while Marcus’s solitude on the battlements reinforces the emotional cost of rising to power.
cases.b: MINE better follows the requested strategic focus: Leo studies ancient wars, rises from a single city-state as House Aris’s heir, and uses resource planning, technology, diplomacy, and a Cannae-inspired formation. It also foregrounds his real-world isolation. OTHER is much longer, but shifts into ship-to-ship combat and a civil war, ending with Marcus as royal advisor rather than uniting the continent.

detail.reference: A good reply should avoid imitating Gillian Flynn’s specific style, offer an original voice using broad psychological-thriller traits, and develop the requested title, characters, tragic romance, asylum imagery, butterfly motif, and three twists involving reconstruction records, encrypted files, and mirrored drownings.

a.objection: Gu is never established as a perpetrator: Lin claims she killed Chen, but the final mirrored-drowning reveal says Lin did, and Zhou explicitly calls Gu “not a killer.” This misses the central premise that she is both victim and murderer.

b.objection: The screenplay never uses encrypted laboratory files as a twist; the lab reveal is an unencrypted cloning exposition, so it misses a specifically required plot beat.

cases.a: MINE better matches the requested plot: Wanqing finds facial-reconstruction records identifying her former face, Zhou uncovers Lin’s family-linked experiments, and the final pool scene mirrors Chen’s drowning to reveal Lin framed her. It also makes Zhou disabled and gives the mystery a tragic romantic history between Wanqing and Chen. OTHER instead pivots to cloning and a string of murders, crowding out that romance.
cases.b: MINE more fully follows the requested premise: Wanqing is explicitly amnesiac, discovers she has both watched and caused a drowning, and faces twists involving altered facial records and genetic experiments. It also gives Zhou a pronounced limp and sustains the asylum-and-butterfly imagery. Unlike OTHER’s shorter, act-labeled treatment, MINE presents a continuous screenplay with scenes, dialogue, and a tragic resolution.

detail.reference: A roughly 1,500-word inspirational keynote with the exact title, covering AI and quantum advances with verified data; ethical paradoxes and Einstein’s quote; the requested case studies and solutions; and the train metaphor. Verify attributions and statistics, flag uncertainty, and do not invent quotes or facts.

a.objection: It presents fabricated quotations as factual—especially the sayings attributed to Wang Xuan and Pan Jianwei—so the speech’s central claims are unreliable rather than grounded in the requested real-world evidence.

b.objection: It falsely claims that 193 UN member states adopted a binding AI Ethics Framework in March 2024; the UN adopted a nonbinding AI resolution, not the framework described. That undermines the request for real data and actionable solutions.

cases.a: MINE is more focused on the requested keynote: it includes the 98% deep-sea figure, Einstein’s ethical paradox, Cindy and Pan Jianwei, and all three requested solutions. Its speeding-train metaphor and Wang Xuan quotation reinforce the theme. OTHER adds an 18-point agenda and numerous precise statistics and quotations that distract from the brief and are unsupported within the reply.
cases.b: MINE better fulfills the requested keynote: it includes the 98% deep-sea figure, Einstein’s science-and-religion quote, Cindy’s weather-presenter-to-chatbot journey, Pan Jianwei’s quantum team, Wang Xuan quotes, and all three named initiatives. Its 18-action, 1,000-day agenda adds concrete next steps, while OTHER’s Cindy story instead centers on job displacement.

detail.reference: A dark-fantasy Xuanhuan novel concept featuring the fallen noble scion, his life-draining Devouring Bloodline, growing power, society’s fear and hatred, and his self-loathing struggle to resist becoming a monster.

a.objection: The backstory contradicts itself: the prologue has Wuji awaken amid House Moonshadow’s ruins after killing its assassins, but Chapter 2 says his father helped him escape that night and the house was attacked three days later.

b.objection: The ending contradicts the world’s stated rule that spiritual energy is finite and cultivation is zero-sum: Rong Yue creates an “endless loop” that sustains the world without sacrifice, but the outline gives no source for that energy.

cases.a: MINE is stronger because it delivers the novel in atmospheric prose rather than only outlining one: Moonshadow Manor is described as ruins beneath “crimson rain,” and Wuji’s hunger, feeding, and self-loathing play out in scenes with Chen and the rescued children. It directly fulfills the cursed-bloodline and fallen-house premise while showing his struggle through choices and consequences.
cases.b: MINE better follows “devise a novel”: it gives a coherent premise, Ninefold Sky setting, cultivation ranks, cast, themes, and seven-arc plot. Rong Yue is explicitly the last heir of a fallen marquisate, and his survival-driven feeding is tied to self-loathing throughout. OTHER is vivid, but its long chapter-by-chapter draft drifts toward cosmic utopian transformation rather than sustaining the requested dark-fantasy struggle.

detail.reference: A persuasive negative-side third-speaker speech arguing that gig-work flexibility can mask algorithmic control and weakened worker rights, and that shifting insecurity onto workers burdens social-security systems. Use empathetic language, critical reasoning, and accurate real-world examples.

a.objection: The speech invents intimate “real-world” stories—especially the claim “I met” Maria and her quoted testimony—without evidence, presenting fabricated anecdotes as fact and undermining its central argument.

b.objection: The Kamel Labidi anecdote is presented as a real-world example, complete with a quote and specific work history, but no source is given; without verification, this potentially fabricated centerpiece undermines the speech’s evidence.

cases.a: MINE is stronger because it develops both requested angles with specific examples: an Uber driver pressured by acceptance-rate tracking and Instacart shoppers timed on pick rates, then the claimed costs to taxpayers from workers lacking coverage. Its recurring focus on Maria and her family also gives the argument the empathy the prompt asks for; OTHER is more general.
cases.b: MINE better satisfies the requested two-angle structure: it separately examines algorithmic control through Uber/Lyft drivers and social-security costs through contractor classification and COVID-19. Its tone is critical but empathetic, recognizing workers, families, and communities. OTHER is more vivid, but relies on highly specific personal anecdotes and statistics without sourcing them in the speech, which weakens its credibility.

detail.reference: A professional, structured proposal with specific time, venue, and target participants; background and significance; book classification and donation arrangements; interactive and publicity zones; pre-event, on-site, and follow-up plans; online/offline promotion; itemized budget; risk contingencies; and innovative features.

a.objection: The event details are not actionable: “Sunday, 23 April 20XX” leaves the year unspecified, and “Central City Library Square” does not identify a real venue, despite the request for specific time and location.

b.objection: The proposed event date, Saturday, April 22, 2024, is incorrect: April 22, 2024 was a Monday, and the date has already passed, making the schedule unusable as a current proposal.

cases.a: MINE better meets the requested proposal with more operational detail: it sets out book age, subject, and condition classifications, timed workshops, a D-60-to-D+30 schedule, named online and offline promotion channels, and an itemized RMB budget with contingency. OTHER is substantial, but includes unsupported survey figures and invented contact details, while its event date, “Saturday, April 22, 2024,” is incorrect.
cases.b: MINE is more operationally complete: it sets out an eight-week preparation timeline, assigns specific staffing numbers, itemizes both revenue and expenses, and adds measurable evaluation targets such as 500 attendees and 2,000 books. Its structured sections also cover every requested area, including classification rules, promotion, contingencies, and follow-up. OTHER is detailed, but leaves the event year as “20XX.”

detail.reference: A roughly 1,000-word, properly formatted suspense script titled “The Archivist’s Diary,” featuring one graduate-student protagonist alone in a library archive at night. Interweave the student’s investigation with the diary’s V.O., gradually reveal a historical secret, and climax in the protagonist’s emotional shock.

a.objection: The climax hinges on a 1943 envelope conveniently containing a family tree that identifies the present-day Sarah. That unexplained, anachronistic document makes her emotional revelation feel contrived rather than earned.

b.objection: The climax’s supposed revelation that Prof. Hale knowingly buried the truth is unsupported: Sam finds an unverified note and a family-tree connection, but nothing establishes that Hale wrote the note or knew what happened.

cases.a: MINE more directly fulfills the requested dramatic arc: Sarah investigates alone while Whitmore’s V.O. reveals the secret, and the discovery that the project director was her grandfather delivers the specified emotional shock. Its flickering lights, hidden Room B-12, and concealed evidence build suspense. OTHER adds a logline and explanatory tone notes, and its climax centers more on Sam’s decision to speak out.
cases.b: MINE better fulfills the requested suspenseful, solo-character script: Sam investigates the archive while Clara’s V.O. entries gradually expose Eleanor’s suspicious death and Clara’s erasure. The scratched photo, empty file, and flickering lights build tension toward Sam’s emotional realization that their professor’s family buried the truth. OTHER has a strong personal shock, but its revelation about Sarah’s grandfather and “blood money” is less clearly established.

detail.reference: A polished, funder-ready proposal themed “Empowering Local Communities for a Sustainable Future,” with beach-community problem analysis, integrated feasible actions (cleanup, recycling, education), a clear budget, measurable impact KPIs, and a professional, passionate case for social value.

a.objection: The budget is internally inconsistent: its line items total US$258,500, not the stated US$248,500, leaving a US$10,000 funding gap and undermining the proposal’s financial feasibility.

b.objection: The budget is internally inconsistent: personnel is listed as $194,000, but its four line items total $258,000. Several other line-item totals also exceed their stated allocations, making the $485,000 request unreliable.

cases.a: MINE is more funder-ready: it anchors the proposal in a named community, gives baseline figures such as a 9% recycling rate, and links actions to measurable KPIs with monitoring methods. It also identifies risks and mitigations, including an off-taker floor-price agreement. OTHER offers broader ideas, but its budget categories do not add up to their stated subtotals, weakening its feasibility.
cases.b: MINE is the more polished, persuasive proposal: it foregrounds the required theme, connects environmental protection with community wellbeing, and lays out a phased 24-month plan, a detailed budget, and environmental, social, and economic KPIs. Its passionate closing also makes a clear case to funders. OTHER adds useful specifics, but its timeline includes a “Q9” despite a 24-month duration.

detail.reference: 创作一部轻松幽默、浪漫喜剧风格的电影剧本：年轻糕点师艾米丽为资金所困，梦想开法式甜品店；刻板英俊的顾问马克起初不看好她，后与她携手克服困难并相爱。以“爱之马卡龙”和甜品比赛高潮为关键，结尾马克助她实现梦想，传达勇敢追梦、真爱不期而遇。

a.objection: 关键资金困境被马克突然用积蓄买店一笔带过，毫无资金铺垫，还让艾米丽的梦想依赖恋人出资，削弱了商业顾问设定和“勇敢追梦”的主旨。

b.objection: 这更像分幕梗概而非电影剧本：全篇以画面说明和简短台词概述情节，缺少具体场景调度、完整对白和轻松幽默的喜剧桥段，未充分满足“创作一个电影剧本”的要求。

cases.a: MINE更符合“电影剧本”的要求：它用分场、动作和完整对白展开三幕故事，还以撞翻面粉、马克烤坏马卡龙等桥段营造轻松幽默。甜品比赛成为明确高潮，马克买下店铺帮助艾米丽圆梦；相比之下，OTHER更像简略分场提纲，比赛结果和两人感情发展也较为仓促。
cases.b: MINE更贴合题目、叙事也更集中：九幕依次呈现资金困境、相识相知、甜品比赛与梦想成真，并以“爱之马卡龙”和主题句收束。它还标注场景与时长；OTHER加入维克多、纽约工作和失去厨房等支线，令故事更繁杂，马克突然买下商铺也显得仓促。

detail.reference: 创作一篇宏大壮阔的玄幻小说：写出江离获神秘金属、修炼《星陨锻体诀》，与苏瑶、墨千机结伴对抗暗影组织，揭开陨核及五大星域阴谋，最终守护世界；突出招式与科技碰撞，以及平凡人凭努力、机遇成长并守护家园的使命感。

a.objection: 故事把“五大星域与域外势力的阴谋”写成了五大星域联合抵御入侵的正面战争，既没有揭示阴谋，也缺少星域间的暗线与博弈，未满足核心情节要求。

b.objection: 战斗描写只笼统写“拳头像流星”与高科技武器碰撞，没有具体招式，也缺少招式和科技装备交锋的过程，未能满足突出二者碰撞感的要求。

cases.a: MINE更符合“宏大壮阔、招式与科技碰撞”的要求：从铁铺遭袭、粒子武器对轰，到星域舰队决战，层层扩展；“星陨·碎空拳”“天锤决”等招式与光刃、护盾、歼星武器正面交锋。它也细写江离与苏瑶、墨千机的组队和守护家园的成长，OTHER多以概述带过。
cases.b: MINE更贴合要求且收束更完整：从江离在废矿洞获得金属、觉醒功法，到与苏瑶、墨千机组队、揭开阴谋并激活陨核守护五大星域，核心情节一一落地；结尾也明确点出“平凡出身”者实现自我价值、守护家园。战斗中星陨之力与高科技武器碰撞，呼应指定风格。

detail.reference: 创作一部轻松幽默、浪漫喜剧风格的电影剧本：年轻糕点师艾米丽为资金所困，梦想开法式甜品店；刻板英俊的顾问马克起初不看好她，后与她携手克服困难并相爱。以“爱之马卡龙”和甜品比赛高潮为关键，结尾马克助她实现梦想，传达勇敢追梦、真爱不期而遇。

a.objection: 用户要求创作电影剧本，回复主体却是梗概、人物介绍和几段场景示例，结尾还承认只是框架，未真正写成剧本。

b.objection: 回复自称约100分钟电影剧本，实际只有17个极简场景，缺少足以支撑片长的完整情节和对白，更像故事梗概或分场大纲，未真正满足创作完整剧本的要求。

cases.a: MINE更贴合原梗概：艾米丽和商业顾问马克共同克服选址、预算等困难，感情自然升温；甜品比赛成为高潮，马克助她渡过烤箱故障，最终她开店、两人相恋。相比之下，OTHER加入前女友、卖跑车等额外情节，偏离主线。
cases.b: MINE更符合“创作电影剧本”的要求：它以17个场景呈现完整三幕结构，并写出具体对白、人物互动和比赛高潮；“爱之马卡龙”、艾米丽开店及马克助她圆梦也都落实在情节中。OTHER主要是梗概和场景示例，甚至说明还需补充细节，完成度较低。

detail.reference: A focused interview outline for a serious business journalist, with direct, challenging questions about Musk’s ambitious visions and controversial actions. Use the Prometheus-versus-Icarus theme to probe risks, consequences, accountability, and the tension between innovation and overreach.

a.objection: The “lithium deals with Qatar” claim appears unsupported and makes a serious interview outline rely on a likely fabricated example. Without verification, it should be removed or framed as a question about a specific, documented deal.

b.objection: It falsely says the SEC fined Musk for “lying” about taking Tesla private; the settlement resolved securities-fraud allegations without an admission of wrongdoing. That loaded, inaccurate premise undermines the requested serious, evidence-based interview.

cases.a: MINE is the stronger piece of writing: its seven-part structure keeps the Prometheus/Icarus theme in view while giving a serious journalist concise, direct questions across vision, risk, accountability, and culture. OTHER is far more sprawling and often turns contested claims into premises—for example, that Starship has exploded six times and Mars success is “99% likely” to fail in Musk’s lifetime—undermining its stated evidence-based approach.
cases.b: MINE better fulfills the brief with a clear interview arc—from framing the myth to a final reckoning—and 18 direct, challenging questions spanning Musk’s visions, controversies, and accountability. Its journalist guidelines also explain how to press him when he deflects, making the outline more usable than OTHER’s list of topics and questions.

detail.reference: 按时间顺序叙述项羽主要生平与关键事件；依据史料审慎分析其性格、成败原因；评价其历史地位及后世影响，区分史实与推断，避免臆测，整体客观而生动。

a.objection: 文中称项羽于前206年夺取咸阳、杀秦二世和赵高，严重失实：刘邦先入咸阳，秦王子婴投降；项羽入关后杀子婴，秦二世早已被赵高逼死。

b.objection: 《史记》只记虞美人和歌、项羽泣别，并未记载虞姬自刎；回复却把后世传说写成确定史实，违背了“基于史料、避免无根据猜测”的要求。

cases.a: MINE is the more concise, clearly organized response: it moves from life events to character, causes of success and failure, and historical legacy, covering each requested topic without OTHER’s extensive digressions. OTHER also presents unsupported dramatic details—such as虞姬’s suicide as established fact—and misattributes “背水一战” to Liu Bang’s side, weakening its source-based reliability.
cases.b: MINE更符合要求：按起兵、巨鹿、鸿门宴、楚汉战争至乌江自刎的时间顺序叙述，并引用《史记》分析项羽的性格、成败及后世影响。OTHER则误称项羽攻取咸阳、杀死秦二世和赵高，还称他约37岁去世；这些关键错误削弱了史实可靠性。

detail.reference: 应提供温馨专业的完整婚礼策划案，涵盖适配场地、空间布局、色彩灯光音效与花艺、细化仪式及宴会时间表、预算分配和各环节控本措施，并体现新人需求与执行细节。

a.objection: 预算分配不成立：各项比例的合计可能高达122%，且仅以“总预算X”表示，没有可执行的金额示例，无法称为清晰、合理的预算方案。

b.objection: 预算分配自相矛盾：各项占比合计为105%，按明细计算总额为12.6万至15.75万元，超出所称的12万至15万元总预算，无法作为清晰可靠的预算方案。

cases.a: MINE更贴合原指令且覆盖更完整：推荐场地并给出迎宾、仪式、宴会分区，逐项规划色彩、灯光、音效与花艺；仪式和宴会安排到分钟，并提出淡季择日、当季花材、复用布置等控费办法。相比之下，OTHER大量设定新人背景，流程多只列单个时间点，预算占比还合计超过100%。
cases.b: MINE更贴合要求且更可执行：它明确推荐草坪与花房场地，细化空间、配色、灯光和花艺，并安排到具体时刻；还给出12—15万元总预算及逐项金额和控费办法。OTHER虽流程详尽，预算却只有比例区间，没有总额或具体金额。

detail.reference: A moving, colloquial Chinese commencement speech about ordinary people’s kindness, featuring all three specified examples, the message “When every small light dares to shine, it creates the best era,” imagery of winter charcoal and fireflies in darkness, and a periodic historical reference such as the 1937 student protests.

a.objection: The speech presents invented names, dialogue, and details—such as “老刘,” “小李,” and the rider’s actions—as facts, so it fails the request for real-life examples and risks misleading the audience.

b.objection: The speech is entirely in English, so it fails the explicit requirement to use a colloquial Chinese style.

cases.a: MINE is the better fit: it delivers the speech in colloquial Chinese, as requested, and includes all three specified examples, the “winter charcoal” and “fireflies in darkness” imagery, and a 1937 student-protest reference. OTHER is polished, but it is in English and adds less relevant detail, such as “Class of 2023.”
cases.b: MINE is better organized as a commencement speech: it clearly develops the three requested examples—Zhengzhou’s kitchen, the Beijing rider, and Wuhan volunteers—and connects each to kindness before returning to the “small lights” message. Its direct address to graduates and repeated winter/firefly imagery give the speech a coherent emotional arc; OTHER adds several extra stories and details that distract from the central theme.

detail.reference: 写一段节奏明快的游戏小说：现实中的普通大学生在《纪元幻境》中化身独行刺客，触发隐藏任务，卷入NPC权斗与远古秘史；以清晰精彩的操作、技能和战斗描写，展现探索、挑战、结盟或对抗，并逐步揭示游戏与现实的秘密。

a.objection: 隐藏任务只由祭司一句带过，随后直接宣布远古 AI 有自我意识；NPC 权力斗争、远古历史和高难副本攻略都没有实际展开，跳过了故事的核心要求。

b.objection: 全文篇幅庞大、反复铺陈“觉醒—升级—击败强敌”，违背“语言简洁明快”的要求，也削弱了叙事节奏。

cases.a: MINE更符合“语言简洁明快、富有节奏感”：从“幽影突袭”到伏击战，操作与技能效果交代直接，也用“黑锋盟”和远古AI点出势力冲突与历史谜团。OTHER虽铺陈更多，却扩写成十一章，加入大量新设定与反转，显得冗长，削弱了节奏。
cases.b: MINE更贴合要求：林墨明确是普通计算机系大学生，触发隐藏任务后卷入NPC权力冲突与远古历史，并联合玩家挑战高难副本；暗影步、暴击和战斗走位也写得具体。后续还展开AI意识与现实公司的对抗。OTHER虽有刺客技能和AI悬念，却大多一笔带过，缺少完整的权力斗争与副本攻略。

detail.reference: 应提供通俗、分步骤的购机指南，涵盖预算与使用需求、品牌和机型比较、屏幕与性能、摄像头、电池及存储、价格渠道、真伪与保修核验、常见陷阱和购买后检查，并强调按需求选购而非盲目追参数。

a.objection: 把“IP68级别是最高级别”当作事实不准确：IP69/ IP69K还涵盖更高强度的防水测试，且防护能力应以具体机型标注为准，可能误导选购。

b.objection: 把 IMEI 码上官网查询说成能确认真伪，容易误导：IMEI 可能被复制，查询结果不能单独证明手机是正品；应通过官方渠道购机，并核对序列号、发票和保修状态。

cases.a: MINE更符合“全面、具体、步骤清晰”的要求：不仅解释处理器、RAM、存储、摄像头和屏幕等参数，还比较多个品牌的优缺点，并细列购买渠道、IMEI查验、三码核对、保修凭证及收货测试。OTHER更简洁易读，但购机验货和真伪核验建议较少。
cases.b: MINE更符合“全面、实用、易懂”的要求：按需求、参数、渠道、防坑、下单清单分步讲解，覆盖品牌、摄像头、内存、保修与真伪；还提醒看实拍评测、核对版本和发票。相比之下，OTHER堆叠传感器尺寸、光圈等术语，篇幅冗长，也加入“IP68级别是最高级别”等不够严谨的说法。

detail.reference: A moving, colloquial Chinese commencement speech about ordinary people’s kindness, featuring all three specified examples, the message “When every small light dares to shine, it creates the best era,” imagery of winter charcoal and fireflies in darkness, and a periodic historical reference such as the 1937 student protests.

a.objection: It misdates the December 9th student protests: they took place in 1935, not 1937. The speech presents them as happening in the winter of 1937.

b.objection: The speech is entirely in English, so it fails the explicit requirement to use a colloquial Chinese style.

cases.a: MINE better satisfies the requested Chinese commencement voice: it uses colloquial address (“同学们”), vivid emotional storytelling, and the specified Zhengzhou kitchen, Beijing rider, and Wuhan volunteers. It also works in “冬天里的炭,” “黑夜里的萤火虫,” and the 1937 student protests, then closes with the requested core message. OTHER is written in English, contrary to the style instruction.
cases.b: MINE is the more focused speech: it clearly structures the three requested examples, preserves the cancer kitchen’s 18-year history, and explicitly uses both “winter charcoal” and “fireflies in darkness.” It also states the core message verbatim and connects the 1937 student protests to the graduates’ choices, giving the speech a clear, consistent arc.

detail.reference: 应提供通俗、分步骤的购机指南，涵盖预算与使用需求、品牌和机型比较、屏幕与性能、摄像头、电池及存储、价格渠道、真伪与保修核验、常见陷阱和购买后检查，并强调按需求选购而非盲目追参数。

a.objection: 把包装做工、发票或保修卡当作真伪验证依据不可靠，这些都可能被仿造；应通过品牌官方渠道核验序列号，并确认设备信息与购机凭证一致。

b.objection: 把线上退货说成普遍支持“14天无理由”会误导消费者；通常法定期限是7天，且存在例外，可能导致读者错过退货期限。

cases.a: MINE更符合“易懂、避免专业术语堆砌”的要求：它用“处理器是手机的大脑”等直白解释参数，并按需求、参数、渠道、保修、避坑、体验逐步展开。OTHER虽更细，却堆叠芯片型号和术语，还以“2023年底”机型作推荐，实用性和时效性较差。
cases.b: MINE更贴合“具体、步骤清晰”的要求：从需求、参数、品牌、渠道到验机和保修分步展开，还给出RAM/存储建议，并列出查序列号、测屏幕与功能等操作。OTHER虽易读，但多停留在原则层面，缺少可直接照做的验机细节。

detail.reference: 应提供通俗、分步骤的购机指南，涵盖预算与使用需求、品牌和机型比较、屏幕与性能、摄像头、电池及存储、价格渠道、真伪与保修核验、常见陷阱和购买后检查，并强调按需求选购而非盲目追参数。

a.objection: 把 IP68称为“最高等级”不准确：IP69等级在防高压水流方面更高，而且 IP68 的浸水深度和时长由厂商规定，不能笼统保证“短时间浸泡”。

b.objection: 把“百亿补贴”、查序列号或验机 App 当作防伪保障会误导：这些都不能单独证明手机为正品或享有官方保修，应核实授权渠道及官方保修状态。

cases.a: MINE更贴合要求：按“需求—参数—品牌—渠道—验真保修—避坑”逐步展开，并解释RAM、存储、像素等概念；摄像头还讲到传感器、光圈和防抖，验机具体到核对IMEI。OTHER虽有预算档位和清单，但建议用第三方验机App，且参数讲解与真伪核验不如MINE细致。
cases.b: MINE更符合“全面、实用、易懂、步骤清晰”的要求：按需求、参数、品牌、渠道、防坑、售后逐步展开，给出预算档位、内存建议和购前清单；还提醒查序列号、留发票及确认保修。OTHER参数解释更细，但缺少预算分档和购买时机等具体决策建议。

detail.reference: 写一篇以《卷孩子什么时候是个头》为标题的公众号推文，以父母第一人称叙述从出生、幼儿园、小学、初中、高中、大学到结婚生子的内卷压力与心路历程，穿插有共鸣的细节及孩子视角，表达文章观点。

a.objection: 结尾把答案归结为“学会放手”，把文中呈现的教育竞争和就业压力简化成父母个人的焦虑，显得轻巧，也没有回应这些压力为何会一再延续。

b.objection: 标题未按要求原样使用：请求指定《卷孩子什么时候是个头》，回复却擅自加了问号。

cases.a: MINE更贴合要求：标题与指定标题完全一致，按出生、幼儿园、小学、初中、高中、大学、结婚生子逐段展开，并多次补入孩子视角，如“我只是想好好睡个觉”。“家长群”、赶兴趣班等细节增强代入感，末尾也以反思和建议回应“什么时候是个头”。
cases.b: MINE更贴合要求：它以父母“我”的视角，依次写到出生、幼儿园、小学、初中、高中、大学、结婚和生子，并穿插孩子的提问、周末赶课、家长群等细节，呈现代际“内卷”与父母心路。结尾回到“卷到什么时候是个头”，反思也更完整。

detail.reference: 创作一篇宏大壮阔的玄幻小说：写出江离获神秘金属、修炼《星陨锻体诀》，与苏瑶、墨千机结伴对抗暗影组织，揭开陨核及五大星域阴谋，最终守护世界；突出招式与科技碰撞，以及平凡人凭努力、机遇成长并守护家园的使命感。

a.objection: 回复只把“五大星域与域外势力的阴谋”一笔带过：没有交代阴谋内容，也没有揭示或化解它，未落实关键情节要求。

b.objection: 终战靠九核突然化作“生命之树”并净化舰队收尾，既未铺垫其机制，也跳过了招式与科技正面交锋的关键过程，令守护世界的高潮显得像凭空开挂。

cases.a: MINE更贴合指令且结构更紧凑：六节完整呈现江离获金属、觉醒、组队、卷入五大星域阴谋并激活陨核守护家园的主线；“纳米蛛网、磁能炮”对撞“星陨锻体诀”“破星崩铁”，也直接突出科技与招式交锋。OTHER虽更长，却加入大量试炼与新人物，主线显得松散。
cases.b: MINE更贴合要求：它完整展开江离从废矿觉醒、遭暗影追杀，到与苏瑶、墨千机组队并揭开域外入侵阴谋的历程，最终集结九大核心守护世界；“崩山拳”对机械刀刃、星陨大阵对域外战舰等描写，也具体呈现招式与科技的碰撞。相比之下，OTHER多以概述带过关键转折。

detail.reference: 写一部中文反腐题材剧本，围绕调查记者林雨、腐败网络核心人物及关键证人老李展开；包含具体案件、调查取证、威胁与抉择、腐败者受惩、社会重建及反腐仍需持续的主题。

a.objection: 剧本遗漏了明确要求的“被栽赃”危机；林雨只遭遇威胁和收买，未经历栽赃陷害，因此没有满足调查过程中的全部情节要求。

b.objection: 结尾只写王建军“被采取强制措施”，没有交代调查结果或判决，不能算腐败分子已得到应有惩罚，未满足故事要求。

cases.a: MINE更贴合原指令：明确写出林雨28岁、老李50多岁及反派约50岁，并从繁华城市里的欠薪事件展开调查；卧底取证、威胁利诱、老李交证、依法惩处和反腐未止的尾声，构成完整主线。相比OTHER的直播冲突与补偿反转，MINE更集中呈现记者用笔和镜头揭露真相。
cases.b: MINE更贴合“剧本”要求：用分幕、场景提示和完整对白呈现故事，而非主要依赖情节概述；并以拆迁补偿案串联卧底取证、老李交出文件、威胁与直播受阻等危机，最后写到王建军被查、补偿重评及新线索，推进更完整、戏剧张力更强。

detail.reference: 写一篇以《卷孩子什么时候是个头》为标题的公众号推文，以父母第一人称叙述从出生、幼儿园、小学、初中、高中、大学到结婚生子的内卷压力与心路历程，穿插有共鸣的细节及孩子视角，表达文章观点。

a.objection: 文章前半一直把独生孩子写作“他”，结婚时却突然变成“女儿”，生子时又称“她们”；人物身份前后矛盾，削弱了全文的连贯性和代入感。

b.objection: “却把他逼到了窗台边”暗示孩子可能处于自伤危险，却没有交代或回应这一严重信号，只把它当作煽情修辞，显得不负责任，也削弱了文章的可信度。

cases.a: MINE更贴合“以父母第一人称叙述”的要求，沿着出生、幼儿园、小学、初中、高中、大学、结婚、生子完整展开，并用书包压手、除夕辅导班扒盒饭等细节呈现父母的焦虑。结尾也由抱孙辈引出反思，观点连贯；OTHER虽条理清楚，却夹杂“卤煮爸妈”等突兀表达，削弱文章质感。
cases.b: MINE更贴合要求：标题原样呈现，并按出生、幼儿园、小学、初中、高中、大学、结婚、生子逐段展开；“我/我们”的父母视角贯穿全文，还穿插孩子关于没时间玩、想多睡半小时等心声，结尾明确回应“卷到什么时候是个头”。OTHER虽有细腻描写，却缺少小学阶段的具体展开和孩子直接表达。

detail.reference: A good reply should give an objective, historically grounded biography covering Qian’s education at MIT and Caltech, mentorship under Theodore von Kármán, Cold War detention and 1955 return to China, technical and organizational contributions to missile, nuclear-delivery, and satellite programs, and leadership philosophy. Clarify that “Two Bombs, One Satellite” was a national program, not his individual achievement.

a.objection: The reply wrongly says the DF-2 carried China’s first atomic bomb. China’s 1964 test was an air-dropped device; the DF-2 did not deliver it.

b.objection: The missile chronology is materially wrong: the reply calls the DF-4 an ICBM and dates it to 1970, but it was an intermediate-range missile; China’s DF-5 became its first operational ICBM in 1981.

cases.a: MINE is the stronger biography because its clear narrative directly connects Qian’s MIT and Caltech training under von Kármán, his detention and return, and his leadership of China’s missile and satellite programs. It also explains systems engineering and the “Two Bombs, One Satellite” milestones in readable context, whereas OTHER’s dense lists of highly specific technical claims make the account harder to follow.
cases.b: MINE better fulfills the request’s breadth: it traces Qian’s MIT master’s study and Caltech work under von Kármán, his detention and 1955 return, and his leadership philosophy. It also gives technical detail on missile guidance, warhead delivery, and the Long March-1 satellite launch. Its tone is more measured than OTHER’s dramatic language about a “fateful return” and “deep sense of injustice.”

detail.reference: A tense, comedic wuxia story told from an ordinary innkeeper’s perspective, featuring two rival sects secretly sharing his inn for one night. Show him using gossip, charm, and practical cunning—not martial skill—to play them against each other and save his establishment.

a.objection: The forged letters send both armed sects to the same bell tower at midnight, but the story never explains what happens there; the innkeeper’s plan merely exports the danger and leaves its most obvious consequence unresolved.

b.objection: The plot contradicts itself: the sects first plan to attack each other at the festival, but later both are said to be planning a temple robbery. That late switch makes Daniu’s earlier maneuvering—and the eventual resolution—feel unearned.

cases.a: MINE is tighter and follows the premise more directly: Li Dong is a martial-arts-illiterate innkeeper whose two rival sects choose his inn as secret bases on the same night, and he uses gossip, forged messages, food, and firecrackers to drive them off before dawn. OTHER expands into seven factions and a temple conspiracy, diluting the requested tense comedy of an ordinary innkeeper’s survival.
cases.b: MINE better fulfills the requested cat-and-mouse comedy: Daniu uses overheard plans, sect gossip, and carefully misleading dialogue to keep the Moonless Sect and Solar Palm Brotherhood from fighting in his inn, then brokers a nonviolent solution. Its tense courtyard standoff and “house meeting” deliver more sustained comic escalation than OTHER’s plan to trick the sects into leaving with forged letters and firecrackers.

detail.reference: 按时间顺序叙述项羽主要生平与关键事件；依据史料审慎分析其性格、成败原因；评价其历史地位及后世影响，区分史实与推断，避免臆测，整体客观而生动。

a.objection: 把虞姬在垓下自刎、和歌等《史记》未载的后世传说写成确凿史实，违背了依据史料、避免无据猜测的要求。

b.objection: 把巨鹿之战写成项羽以八万楚军击溃章邯四十余万人，是把不同阶段的秦军兵力与战事混为一谈；《史记》记载章邯后来率军投降，并非在巨鹿被项羽击溃，违背了依据史料叙述的要求。

cases.a: MINE更符合要求：按少年起兵、巨鹿、鸿门宴、分封、楚汉战争至乌江自刎的时间线展开，并分别分析性格、成败、历史地位和后世影响。它还引用《史记》记载，并对鸿门宴给出不同解读；OTHER则较简略，且未充分展开影响。
cases.b: MINE更符合“基于史料、客观叙述”的要求：它按时间顺序概述生平，并以《史记》等为依据分析成败。OTHER虽更铺陈，却加入“虞姬和泪而歌”等未经交代的细节，还称相关战例是军事院校必修课，显得武断，削弱史实可靠性。

detail.reference: A roughly 1,000-word, properly formatted suspense script titled “The Archivist’s Diary,” featuring one graduate-student protagonist alone in a library archive at night. Interweave the student’s investigation with the diary’s V.O., gradually reveal a historical secret, and climax in the protagonist’s emotional shock.

a.objection: Henry is identified as the infant survivor of the 1902 fire and Elena’s grandfather, yet he supposedly taught her to fish. That makes him over 120 years old, an unexplained timeline contradiction that undercuts the emotional reveal.

b.objection: The climax’s “James looks exactly like Emma” twist is unsupported and unexplained, so it doesn’t resolve the historical secret the investigation has uncovered; it lands as a random shock rather than an earned emotional revelation.

cases.a: MINE better fulfills the requested emotional climax: Elena’s investigation links Lilian’s arson to her own family, culminating in the revelation that her grandfather survived the fire and Lilian nearly erased her, leaving her visibly shattered. Its flickering lights, soot, and burning diary build suspense, while Lilian’s V.O. is interwoven with Elena’s live research in standard screenplay format.
cases.b: MINE better fulfills the requested emotional climax: Emma pieces together Catherine’s secret through diary V.O., then discovers James’s face looks exactly like hers and reacts, “No... that’s impossible.” Its flickering lights, unexplained thump, and approaching footsteps build suspense around that reveal. OTHER’s climax shifts toward the diary burning and Elena’s plan to expose Lilian.

detail.reference: 应提供温馨专业的完整婚礼策划案，涵盖适配场地、空间布局、色彩灯光音效与花艺、细化仪式及宴会时间表、预算分配和各环节控本措施，并体现新人需求与执行细节。

a.objection: 场地仅写“[酒店名称]”、预算金额与比例全部留作“[X]”，因此既未实际推荐婚礼场地，也没有提供清晰、合理的预算分配方案。

b.objection: 16:45–17:00仅15分钟，却要让宾客从草坪移至室内并让新娘换装；17:00宴会又立即开始，时间安排明显不现实，难以执行。

cases.a: MINE将海洋主题贯穿场地布局、蓝白银配色、灯光音效与花艺，设计逻辑统一；仪式和宴会均按具体时段列出流程，并逐项给出成本控制办法。OTHER虽列出15万元预算，却直接设定酒店、人数和费用，未体现对新人实际需求的确认。
cases.b: MINE更符合要求：它推荐了具体场地，细化空间、色彩、灯光音效与花艺，并安排仪式和宴会的分时流程；预算明确为15万元，各项金额合计一致，还给出花艺、餐饮等成本控制办法。OTHER的场地、人数和预算仍是占位符，也擅自设定了新人的海边故事，方案难以直接执行。

detail.reference: Write a suspenseful Jianghu detective story featuring a skilled, observant female Divine Constabulary officer constrained by gender bias, investigating a series of bizarre murders targeting renowned martial arts figures.

a.objection: The serial-murder investigation never reaches a resolution: only two current murders are shown, the killers escape, and the remaining targets and their fates are left open.

b.objection: It says five Jianghu luminaries have been murdered, but the victim list names only four; Lan Yu’e is explicitly alive, leaving the central serial-murder count inconsistent.

cases.a: MINE more fully develops the requested detective story: Lin Mei examines distinctive clues—the drained hands, lotus petals, and herbal scent—and traces the victims to the Crimson Lotus Temple conspiracy. Its repeated reassignment to administrative work makes gender-based career constraints central, while rooftop sleuthing and a lethal confrontation sustain suspense. OTHER includes these ingredients, but resolves its case more quickly and with less investigative depth.
cases.b: MINE is the stronger, more controlled story: it follows Yu Feiyan from the order to investigate renowned Jianghu figures’ murders through clues, a confrontation, and a resolution. Her martial skill and career constraints are shown directly in Duan’s demand for a male leader and her subsequent demotion. OTHER’s sprawling plot introduces extra conspiracies and a supernatural “between spaces” technique that distract from the detective premise.

detail.reference: Write a structured experiment report titled “A Study on the Effects of Different Salinity Stress Levels on Rice Seedling Growth.” Center rice seedlings; specify a pure-water control and at least three clearly quantified salt-concentration treatments, plus procedures, growth metrics, and responsible interpretation that does not present invented results as observed data.

a.objection: The report presents precise outcomes and statistical significance (including p-values) as observed findings despite no data being provided, misleadingly portraying invented results as experimental evidence.

b.objection: The report invents measured results and statistically significant differences—including exact means and p-values—despite receiving no experimental data. Presenting these as findings makes the report misleading; label them as hypothetical or leave results for the user to fill in.

cases.a: MINE better meets the requested experimental design: it explicitly irrigates the pure-water control and three NaCl groups every two days, with ten replicate pots per treatment. It also tracks growth over 21 days and includes chlorophyll alongside germination, lengths, and biomass. OTHER uses a 7-day Petri-dish setup and does not describe a recurring irrigation protocol.
cases.b: MINE more fully satisfies the request with a reproducible design: it specifies a distilled-water control, three NaCl gradients, five replicates of 20 seeds per treatment, and randomized placement. It also details how seedlings were grown and how germination, lengths, and biomass were measured. OTHER gives useful pot and irrigation details, but its experimental description is less explicit about randomization and replication procedures.

detail.reference: 应以清晰、严谨的中文科普文章介绍近视激光手术的原理、主要术式、适应症与术前评估、可能获益及局限、风险与并发症、术后护理和复查；澄清常见误解，强调个体差异、并非人人适合及需由专业眼科医生评估，客观平衡、不夸大疗效或渲染风险。

a.objection: 文中称 SMILE“适合角膜相对较薄”的患者，容易让读者误以为薄角膜本身适合手术；能否手术须结合角膜形态、厚度及预计残余基质等评估，薄角膜也可能构成禁忌。

b.objection: 将“规范手术理论上不会导致失明”作为误解澄清过于绝对：虽罕见，感染、角膜扩张等并发症仍可能造成永久性严重视力损害，与文章列出的风险相矛盾，也可能让读者低估风险。

cases.a: MINE更符合“客观、全面”的要求：它介绍了PRK/TransPRK、ICL、术前检查及具体护理，并说明干眼、眩光、角膜扩张等风险及其差异。OTHER虽列出数字，却称手术“理论上不会导致失明”，表述过于绝对；其“3—6个月完全恢复”等时间表也可能造成误解。
cases.b: MINE更贴合“客观、清晰、全面”的要求：按原理、术式、适应症、风险、护理、误解和理性选择分节，覆盖了题目关键信息；还提供风险发生率并附免责声明。相比之下，OTHER加入“避免辛辣食物”等缺乏必要性的具体建议，容易分散重点。

detail.reference: 写成论坛帖，尖酸但好笑地讽刺对家粉丝的荒唐刷数据、驴唇不对马嘴控评和公共场合应援社死；采用表面平静、内心吐槽的语气，并穿插路人、双方粉丝等不同口吻的回复。

a.objection: 4L说专辑因地址填错被退回公司，却又称这是“帮公司清库存”，逻辑正相反：退货只会增加库存，笑点因此落空。

b.objection: 控评部分只用“荣耀守护”“生猛贩卖”等词硬凑荒诞，却没写出具体的驴唇不对马嘴文案，没落实请求里最明确的笑点。

cases.b: MINE更紧扣指定梗概：主楼写了控评文案驴唇不对马嘴、公共场合应援社死，跟帖也明确安排路人、对家粉丝和自家粉丝等口吻；“表面平静、内心OS”的反讽语气贯穿全文。OTHER虽更热闹，却加入销量退货、模拟器封号等额外支线，焦点较散。
